name: Inbound Lead Webhook → Find Email + Enrich → Airtable

parameters.content:
## 3 · Inbound Lead Webhook → Find Email + Enrich → Airtable

**What it does:** A form/CRM/site POSTs a new lead (name + company domain). The flow finds a verified work email, enriches the person, and writes one row to Airtable (a Google Sheet works the same way — swap the last node).

**Setup**
1. **Lead Webhook** → copy the Production URL into your form/CRM/Zapier/site. Expects JSON `{ name, website }` (website = company domain).
2. **Find Email** & **Enrich Person** → your FoxAPIs key.
3. **Upsert to Airtable** → pick Base + Table.

**Credentials & key**
- **Find Email** + **Enrich Person** → your **FoxAPIs API key** (`fxp_live_…`) from **foxapis.com**, spending **FoxAPIs credits**. Not a MentionFox connection token.

**Credit cost per lead:** find email **100 cr on a match (0 cr if no email)** + enrich **100 cr Light**. Budget ~200 cr per fully-resolved lead.

Pricing: https://mentionfox.com/pricing

nodes.name: Lead Webhook
nodes.notes: POST JSON: { "name": "Jane Doe", "website": "acme.com" }. Copy the Production URL into your form/CRM.

nodes.name: Find Email
nodes.notes: POST /v1/find_email {website, name}. FoxAPIs key. 100 cr on a match, 0 cr when no email is found.

nodes.name: Enrich Person
nodes.notes: POST /v1/enrich_person — adds title, company, links, identity confidence. FoxAPIs key. 100 cr Light.

nodes.name: Upsert to Airtable
nodes.notes: Writes one enriched lead row. Swap for Google Sheets if you prefer.
